graphs.title: Distribution of Household Expenditure
graphs.description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of an average household`s monthly expenditure across various categories.

question: According to the pie chart, the percentage of household expenditure on Housing is ___________ times the percentage spent on ___________ .
title: Household Expenditure Comparison: Housing vs. Other Categories
solution:
To solve this question, we need to identify the percentage of household expenditure on Housing and compare it to another category from the pie chart.

From the pie chart, we can see:
- Expenditure on Housing is 30\%
- Expenditure on Entertainment is 7\%

To find how many times the Housing expenditure is compared to Entertainment expenditure, we need to calculate the ratio:

Ratio = \frac{\text{Percentage of Housing Expenditure}}{\text{Percentage of Entertainment Expenditure}} = \frac{30\%}{7\%}

Ratio = \frac{30}{7} \approx 4.29

Therefore, the household expenditure on Housing is approximately 4.29 times the expenditure on Entertainment.
